sloka: क्R^त्येष्वचोदितः पित्रा सर्वस्यान्तः पुरस्य च ।गतिर्यः शरणम् चासीत् स रोओमोऽद्य प्रवत्स्यति ॥२-२०-२॥
transliteration: kR^tyeṣvacoditaḥ pitrā sarvasyāntaḥ purasya ca ।gatiryaḥ śaraṇam cāsīt sa roomo'dya pravatsyati ॥2-20-2॥

translations.english: Rama was the refuge and protector of all the inmates lot of the inner apartment although it was not his duty nor was he forced by his father to safeguard them. That Rama is now going on exile.
